notes on the frame layout
# Zstandard Frames: 1
A frame opens with a magic number and a frame header. The header says
whether the content size is stored; when it is not, zstd -lv prints no
Decompressed Size line and no Ratio line for the file.
DictID: 0
Window Size: 12 B (12 B)
The window size is what the decoder has to keep in memory.
